runtimeBoundaryScan.meaning: The donor tree is not browser/Cloudflare-native. Node filesystem, process, PTY, shell and server assumptions must remain behind a local companion or be rewritten for OCADE-native browser abstractions.

standaloneHealth.note: These numbers come from the archive's own validation receipt and mean the donor tree is not a standalone build snapshot.

provenanceAndLicence.commercialShippingStatus: UNRESOLVED — do not ship donor source or derivative ports commercially until provenance/rights are confirmed for the relevant code.
provenanceAndLicence.repositoryPolicy: Private staging/reference is separated from production wiring. Production integration must be selective, attributable and reviewed.

observedCompatibilityRisks: Donor validation reports 357 unique unresolved relative imports.
Donor validation reports 2178 TS2307 missing-module diagnostics after sanitization.
Donor web application is a second Next.js router/runtime and must not be mounted beside TanStack Start.
CLI/tool runtime assumes filesystem, shell, PTY and Node/Bun capabilities unavailable in Cloudflare Workers.
Donor QueryEngine uses a different model/protocol/service stack and must be adapted to OCADE's local WebGPU/WASM authority.
Donor Next file read/write routes resolve arbitrary paths and are not acceptable public web endpoints.
The existing OCADE repository already has agent loop, tool registry, browser Cowork, extension, local AI and permissions, so direct donor registration would duplicate authority.
The donor package is marked UNLICENSED and contains no LICENSE file; commercial reuse rights are not established by the archive itself.

observedReferenceStrings.note: These are classification/provenance observations, not proof of an active hosted-model route.

recommendedStrategy: Preserve the archive under a quarantined import namespace, then port only reusable logic into the existing OCADE-native architecture with adapters and tests. Never place the donor root directly under production src/ and never activate its provider/server/runtime authority wholesale.
